summary: Validated selection-index setter on `this`: an a2 of -1 unconditionally clears this[2] (offset 0x8) to -1; otherwise the index is stored into this[2] only when the entry flag at this[a2 + 3] is non-zero and the global enable gate dword_7CF788 is non-zero. Always returns the original a2.

operations.description: Cache the incoming index as the return value: result = a2.
Test whether the index a2 equals -1 (invalid/clear request).
Clear the stored selection: this[2] = -1 when a2 is -1.
For a non-negative index, require the entry validation flag this[a2 + 3] to be non-zero before accepting it.
Require the enable gate global dword_7CF788 (0x007CF788) to be non-zero before storing the validated index.
Store the validated index: this[2] = a2 when the entry flag and enable gate both pass.
Called by sub_4D8450 (004D8450) to set a validated selection index through this gate.
